sanskrit: indra jyeṣṭhaṃ na ā bhara ojiṣṭhaṃ pupuri śravaḥ . yaddidhṛkṣema vajrahasta rodasī obhe suśipra paprāḥ
english: O Indra, bring to us the foremost, most powerful glory. When we would hold firm both heaven and earth, O wielder of the thunderbolt, O fair-cheeked one, you have filled them both.

sanskrit: indro rājā jagataścarṣaṇīnāmadhikṣamā viśvarūpaṃ yadasya . tato dadāti dāśuṣe vasūni codadrādha upastutaṃ cidarvāk
english: Indra is king of the world, of all peoples — whatever of all forms is his pervades the earth. From that wealth he gives to the worshipper; he who urges on, though praised, comes forward.

sanskrit: yasyedamā rajoyujastuje jane vanaṃ svaḥ . indrasya rantyaṃ bṛhat
english: His is this realm — yoked for the contest, for the people, the forest, the sun: great is the delight of Indra.

sanskrit: uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya . athāditya vrate vayaṃ tavānāgaso aditaye syāma
english: Loosen from us the highest snare, O Varuṇa, and loose the lowest; unloose the middle one. Then, O Āditya, in your covenant may we be sinless, free for Aditi.

sanskrit: tvayā vayaṃ pavamānena soma bhare kṛtaṃ vi cinuyāma śaśvat . tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
english: Through you, O Soma flowing bright, may we gather perpetually the treasure won in battle. May Mitra and Varuṇa magnify that for us, and Aditi, the River, the Earth, and Heaven.

sanskrit: imaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ kṛṇutaikaminmām
english: Make this one bull — make me this alone.

sanskrit: sa na indrāya yajyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ . varivovitparisrava
english: Flow around and grant wide space for us — for Indra the worshipful, for Varuṇa, for the Maruts.

sanskrit: enā viśvānyarya ā dyumnāni mānuṣāṇām . siṣāsanto vanāmahe
english: With this may we, desiring to win, obtain all the glories of humankind, O lord.

sanskrit: ahamasmi prathamajā ṛtasya pūrvaṃ devebhyo amṛtasya nāma . yo mā dadāti sa idevamāvadahamannamannamadantamadmi
english: I am the firstborn of the cosmic order; I bear the name of immortality before the gods. Whoever gives to me — thus does he declare — I, being food, eat him who eats no food.

sanskrit: paruṣṇīṣu ruśatpayaḥ
english: In the Paruṣṇī rivers flows the bright milk.

sanskrit: arūrucaduṣasaḥ pṛśniragriya ukṣā mimeti bhuvaneṣu vājayuḥ . māyāvino mamire asya māyayā nṛcakṣasaḥ pitaro garbhamādadhuḥ
english: The dappled one, the dawn, blazed forth; the bull, foremost among cows, bellows seeking strength throughout the worlds. Wise seers measured out his magic with his magic; the fathers, beholding men, received the embryo.

sanskrit: indra iddharyoḥ sacā sammiśla ā vacoyujā . indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ
english: Indra alone — together with his two bay horses, yoked by his word — is mixed in with them. Indra, the thunderbolt-wielder, is golden.

sanskrit: indra vājeṣu no 'va sahasrapradhaneṣu ca . ugra ugrābhirūtibhiḥ
english: O Indra, protect us in contests and in the thousand-prize races, O mighty one, with your mighty aids.

sanskrit: prathaśca yasya saprathaśca nāmānuṣṭubhasya haviṣo haviryat . dhāturdyutānātsavituśca viṣṇo rathantaramā jabhārā vasiṣṭhaḥ
english: He whose name is Pratha and Sapratha — the offering of the Anuṣṭubh hymn, which is an oblation — from Dhātar shining bright and from Savitṛ and Viṣṇu, Vasiṣṭha brought forth the Rathantara chant.

sanskrit: niyutvānvāyavā gahyayaṃ śukro ayāmi te . gantāsi sunvato gṛham
english: Come, O Vāyu, with your team of horses; this bright one is offered to you. You shall go to the home of the one who presses the soma.

sanskrit: yajjāyathā apūrvya maghavanvṛtrahatyāya . tatpṛthivīmaprathayastadastabhnā uto divam
english: When you were born, O bountiful one, peerless, for the slaying of Vṛtra — then you spread out the earth, and you propped up the sky.

sanskrit: parameṣṭhī prajāpatirdivi dyāmiva dṛṃhatu
english: May Parameṣṭhin Prajāpati make firm in heaven as he makes firm the sky.

sanskrit: saṃ te payāṃsi samu yantu vājāḥ saṃ vṛṣṇyānyabhimātiṣāhaḥ . āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravāṃsyuttamāni dhiṣva
english: May your milky streams come together, may your strengths come together, may your virile powers come together, O soma that overwhelms the foe. Waxing to fullness for immortality, O Soma, place your highest glories in the sky.

sanskrit: tvamimā oṣadhīḥ soma viśvāstvamapo ajanayastvaṃ gāḥ . tvamātanorurvā3ntarikṣaṃ tvaṃ jyotiṣā vi tamo vavartha
english: You, O Soma, are all these plants; you gave birth to the waters; you produced the cows. You stretched out the wide mid-air; you with your light drove away the darkness.

sanskrit: agnimīḍe purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam . hotāraṃ ratnadhātamam
english: I praise Agni, the household priest, the divine minister of the sacrifice, the invoker, the greatest bestower of treasure.

sanskrit: te manvata prathamaṃ nāma gonāṃ triḥ sapta paramaṃ nāma janān . tā jānatīrabhyanūṣata kṣā āvirbhuvannaruṇīryaśasā gāvaḥ
english: They conceived the first name of the cows; thrice seven the highest name they knew among peoples. Knowing those names, the dawning ones sang out — the ruddy, glorious cows appeared upon the earth.

sanskrit: samanyā yantyupayantyanyāḥ samānamūrvaṃ nadyaspṛṇanti . tamū śuciṃ śucayo dīdivāṃsamapānnapātamupa yantyāpaḥ
english: Some go together, others come flowing together; the rivers fill the same trough. The pure waters flow toward him — pure, shining bright, the child of waters who does not eat food.

sanskrit: ā prāgādbhadrā yuvatirahnaḥ ketūntsamīrtsati . abhūdbhadrā niveśanī viśvasya jagato rātrī
english: The auspicious young maiden of day has come forward, stirring up the banners of light. Night has become the auspicious one who brings to rest all the moving world.

sanskrit: prakṣasya vṛṣṇo aruṣasya nū mahaḥ pra no vaco vidathā jātavedase . vaiśvānarāya matirnavyase śuciḥ soma iva pavate cāruragnaye
english: Now of the mighty, ruddy, vigorous one declare to the assembly our speech for Jātavedas. A fresh pure thought flows clear as soma for the dear Agni Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit: viśve devā mama śṛṇvantu yajñamubhe rodasī apāṃ napācca manma . mā vo vacāṃsi paricakṣyāṇi vocaṃ sumneṣvidvo antamā madema
english: Let all the gods hear my sacrifice — both heaven and earth, and the child of the waters — hear my hymn. May I not speak words reprehensible to you; in your graces may we rejoice to the utmost.

sanskrit: yaśo mā dyāvāpṛthivī yaśo mendrabṛhaspatī . yaśo bhagasya vindatu yaśo mā pratimucyatām . yaśasvyā3syāḥ saṃ sado 'haṃ pravaditā syām
english: May heaven and earth grant me glory; may Indra and Bṛhaspati grant me glory. May Bhaga's glory find me; may glory be released toward me. May I be a proclaimer of glory at this seat of the glorious one.

sanskrit: indrasya nu vīryāṇi pravocaṃ yāni cakāra prathamāni vajrī . ahannahimanvapastatarda pra vakṣaṇā abhinatparvatānām
english: Now I will proclaim the heroic deeds of Indra, the first great acts that the thunderbolt-wielder performed. He slew the serpent; he bored through the flank; he split open the bellies of the mountains.

sanskrit: agnirasmi janmanā jātavedā ghṛtaṃ me cakṣuramṛtaṃ ma āsan . tridhāturarko rajaso vimāno 'jasraṃ jyotirhavirasmi sarvam
english: I am Agni by birth, Jātavedas by name; clarified butter is my eye, immortality my mouth. The hymn of three elements, the measurer of the atmosphere — I am the ceaseless light, I am all the oblation.
